# Amazon.co.uk

> Amazon.co.uk is the UK's leading ecommerce marketplace offering low prices across electronics, books, sports equipment, and millions of other products with Prime membership benefits.

Amazon.co.uk serves as the primary shopping destination for UK customers, featuring curated product discovery through bestsellers and new releases, daily deals and promotional offers, and integrated Prime Video streaming. The platform supports multiple seller programs including Fulfilment by Amazon, Amazon Handmade, and Brand Registry for merchants.

## Key Topics

- Amazon Prime

## Core Shopping & Discovery

- [Amazon.co.uk Homepage](https://www.amazon.co.uk): Amazon.co.uk homepage with electronics, books, sports, and shopping categories
- [Best Sellers](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/bestsellers): Amazon.co.uk bestsellers and most popular items across product categories
- [Hot New Releases](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/new-releases): Amazon.co.uk hot new releases and upcoming bestselling products
- [Today's Deals](https://www.amazon.co.uk/deals): Amazon Today's Deals with daily Lightning Deals and limited-time savings
- [Amazon Haul](https://www.amazon.co.uk/haul/store): Amazon Haul discount shopping hub with ultra-affordable products under £20
- [Amazon Basics Store](https://www.amazon.co.uk/stores/page/5D96C4AA-F0F4-415F-90A4-B202C6B03A17): Amazon Basics store with everyday items, electronics, and home essentials

## Membership & Entertainment

- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.co.uk/prime): Amazon Prime membership with subscription plans, benefits, and Prime Video
- [Prime Video](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/video/storefront): Prime Video streaming service with movies, TV shows, sports, and live TV

## Account & Authentication

- [Amazon Sign-In](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/css/order-history): Amazon account sign-in page with authentication and passkey support
